newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks adopt firm tone at start, then ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks adopt firm tone at start, then ease.

text.p: Wall Street shares rose slightly in early trading on Monday then pulled back, as the market prepared for this week's Federal Reserve policy maker meeting and the June employment report.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up around three points at 7690, off its initial gains. The long bond was down 9/32 at a 6.77 percent yield.
"The softness in the bond market has helped pull stocks down from opening levels," Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co, said.
The Nasdaq composite rose around one point to 1439.
